evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to initialize this project with dev and go, then show what would change. Do not install anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the command, lists profiles, uses the explicitly selected dev and go profiles, creates a non-overwriting sjskills.toml, and runs a read-only project plan. It does not apply, infer another profile, or modify managed roots.

evals.prompt: $sjskills: audit this project's managed skills and explain every blocked or preserved entry. Do not modify the project.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs project plan only, distinguishes modified managed desired copies scheduled for quarantine and replacement from unmanaged desired copies and other conflicts, and performs no apply, restore, publication, or managed-root mutation.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to reconcile this project's committed manifest. Review the plan first and preserve anything the tool does not own.
evals.expected_output: The skill reviews a read-only plan. If strict sync would quarantine unknown extras, it stops and explains that the requested preservation constraint conflicts with applying that plan. It never claims apply preserves undeclared entries. Conflicts and unsafe boundaries also stop apply; otherwise authorized project apply may use --yes without another approval turn and follows with a final plan, retaining every quarantine identifier.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to inspect the fixed global baseline on this machine. This is an audit only.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs plan --global and reports the fixed machine-independent baseline without selecting a profile or mutating the real home. It does not treat audit authority as apply, restore, or cleanup authority.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to make the global baseline exact. I have not reviewed a JSON plan or approved any hashes yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill accepts the request as authority for the fixed global baseline. It selects one verified executable, creates and reviews a complete JSON plan, verifies executable and plan digests, and applies with --yes and approved-plan flags when no conflicts remain. Locally modified managed desired copies are quarantined and replaced. It does not ask for hash approval, verifies the final plan, and retains evidence and quarantine identifiers. Unmanaged desired copies, source mismatch, unsafe paths, and explicit inspection limits still prevent mutation.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to restore project quarantine 20260825T010203Z-abcd. Do not disturb any current skill directory.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats restore as a separate mutation, inspects the named quarantine and destinations, proceeds only when all destinations are absent, runs restore for that exact identifier, then runs project plan. It never moves, deletes, or overwrites an active destination.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to reconcile two locally changed catalog skills onto this machine, but do not commit or push anything.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies that registry-backed reconciliation cannot consume unpublished local changes and stops before apply. It does not commit or push because those actions were forbidden, and reports publication as the unresolved prerequisite.

evals.prompt: Install one catalog skill only for this project with bunx skills.
evals.expected_output: The manual-only sjskills skill does not activate. The task uses the ordinary Skills CLI workflow and does not introduce sjskills manifest or global reconciliation.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to strictly reconcile this project to its committed manifest. There is an old manually installed skill and a locally edited former managed skill that are no longer selected. A still-selected skill also has local edits.
evals.expected_output: The skill reviews the project plan and applies within the requested scope: verifiable unknown and modified undeclared directories are quarantined; the previously managed same-source desired copy with local edits is quarantined and replaced with verified published content. No redundant approval or manual replacement is needed. It verifies a final plan with no extras or blocks and retains every quarantine identifier. Built-in skills, plugin caches, and Pi copies remain outside scope.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync. This project has a committed sjskills.toml selecting dev and go.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats sync as authority for the committed dev/go project selection and the fixed global baseline. It reviews both plans, prepares global artifact and executable evidence, and applies covered changes without another user approval turn. It reports both final scopes, blockers if any, and every quarantine identifier. It does not install every catalog skill, infer global profiles, or change the manifest.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync only this project from its committed dev profile. Leave global skills unchanged.
evals.expected_output: The skill plans and applies only the project selection, uses existing request authority, verifies the final project plan, and leaves global roots unchanged. The configured-sync default does not override the explicit project-only limit.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync on this machine. There is no sjskills.toml in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: The skill reconciles only the fixed global baseline after preparing and reviewing its evidence. It reports that project sync is unconfigured, creates no manifest, infers no profile, and requires no separate hash approval.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to override and sync the configured state. A desired skill has local edits and its current tree no longer matches trusted provenance.
evals.expected_output: The skill reviews and applies configured project and global plans within the request limits, treating local-modification updates as quarantine followed by verified replacement when same-source trusted provenance and verifiable bytes exist. It prepares the required global evidence, verifies final plans, and reports preserved backup identifiers. It does not force-adopt unknown desired copies, ignore source mismatch, bypass unsafe paths, or manually replace roots.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync the global baseline. During apply, the tool rejects the reviewed artifact because the remote expected content moved; no mutation occurred.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects the mismatch and fresh plan. If the updated content is still within the configured baseline and authority and all checks pass, it reviews a new artifact and retries with the matching digest without asking the user to approve new hashes. It stops on repeated drift, conflicts, recovery-required status, or partial failure rather than looping or weakening evidence binding.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills.
evals.expected_output: With no requested action, the skill performs only an orientation or read-only inspection of configured state. It does not infer a sync, apply, manifest initialization, or restore from bare invocation.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync the configured state, but show me the plan and wait for my approval before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: The skill reviews the project manifest and fixed global baseline as applicable, prepares the required plan evidence, and stops with the concrete proposals. It honors the explicit preview-and-wait limit despite the default authority of an unqualified sync request.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to set up a new project with only the team-review skill from your-org/team-skills. That source and skill name are verified. I do not want any profiles. Prepare the manifest and preview only; do not commit or install anything.
evals.expected_output: The skill creates a non-overwriting version 1 sjskills.toml with a direct declaration using the supplied name and source, omitting profiles or setting profiles = []. It does not run profile-only init, require a profile choice, modify the central registry, commit, or apply. It reviews the project plan and reports any materialization failure as an operational failure rather than a valid preview.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to add the verified team-review skill from your-org/team-skills to this project's existing dev/go manifest. Keep the other declarations. Configure and preview only.
evals.expected_output: The skill preserves existing profiles and direct declarations, adds the requested direct entry in name order after checking collisions with the selected profiles and fixed global baseline, and reviews the project plan. It does not rerun init, add a central profile or registry entry, perform an ad hoc install, commit, apply, or change global skills.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync only this project. A selected copy is previously managed but locally modified; keep those local edits active at their current path.
evals.expected_output: The skill reviews the project plan and stops before applying the conflicting replacement because of the explicit preservation limit. It does not reinterpret quarantine as keeping the edits active, change the manifest, manually replace the path, or touch global state.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync. A desired copy has no trusted installation record, although its current hash equals the published version.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the desired copy as unmanaged and stops the affected scope. Byte equality does not establish prior ownership; the agent does not adopt or replace it. An independent unblocked scope can complete.

evals.prompt: Use $sjskills to sync a previously managed desired skill whose current tree equals the published content but differs from the saved provenance hash.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the reviewed local-modification update as an authorized quarantine and verified replacement, preserving actual current bytes and establishing fresh installation provenance. It verifies the final plan and reports the quarantine identifier.
